PR #87 "[B2] Page structure: Board, Priorities and Dump" is open, and CI is green on its head (`e7eeade`): all 8 checks passed, including e2e. Branch `claude/page-structure-b2` has one commit per page plus a docs commit. Nothing was merged. I've unsubscribed from the PR, since my work ends once CI is green.

https://github.com/Marsuu1994/mars-workbench/pull/87

## Changes per page (no behavior change)
- **Board:** `KanbanBoard` is renamed `BoardPage`. It now holds the old `BoardScreen` layout, header and progress dashboard, and `BoardScreen` is deleted. A new `BoardPageContext` holds `pullToTodo`, so `MobileBacklogCard` no longer takes `onPull`. `toBoardCards` and the three frames are unchanged.
- **Priorities:** `PriorityMatrixPage` is renamed `PrioritiesPage`, and `PrioritiesScreen` is deleted.
  - Three new pure functions with unit tests: the route adapter `toPrioritiesPageProps`, `groupTasksByQuadrant` and `isTrackedTask`. "Is this task tracked" is now computed in one place instead of two.
  - A new `PrioritiesPageContext` supplies `activePlanId`, the popover state and every write, so components no longer take callback props. `QuadrantCell` and `MatrixTaskCard` drop from 9 props to 2 each, and the popover, sheet and rows shrink to match.
- **Dump:** `DumpScreen` is renamed `DumpPage`. It gets the unit-tested adapter `toDumpPageProps` and a `DumpPageContext` holding `capture`, `captureError` and `loadMore`.
- **Design Console:** the scenarios render the three containers and pass fixtures through the same adapters as the routes. The gallery's mobile backlog card and matrix card render inside inert contexts.
- **Docs:** I updated `baseline.md`, AGENTS.md, the Design Console README, the tracker (the item is deleted and the `'use client'` half-sentence that no longer applies is dropped), README Current State and today's Update Log. The spike moved to `design/spike/archived/`.

## Checks
- **Before pushing:** format, lint, typecheck and knip passed. `npm test` passed:
notes: Scope: 197 of the 412 assistant/user events carry a parent_tool_use_id, i.e. the four subagents' own turns are interleaved in this transcript (Board 41, Priorities 83, Dump 35, ui-verifier 38 events). `usage` and `process` sum everything; `usage_main_session` / `process_main_session` are the main session alone (71 of 139 requests, 65 of 141 tool calls). Do not add agent_calls[].subagent_tokens on top of `usage` (they are already in it); add them to `usage_main_session` instead.

output_tokens are not usable: every event of a message carries the same usage and it is the streaming message_start value (7 output tokens for the message that carried the three Agent prompts, 14k chars; 24 for the create_pull_request call with a 7.5k-char body); only the final text message (810 tokens for 3.9k chars) looks final, and stop_reason is null on every message. Input-side counts (input, cache_creation, cache_read) are fixed at message_start and are consistent. Cross-check: the harness's per-subagent totals (Board 101,941; Priorities 156,875; Dump 94,325; ui-verifier 49,852) equal input + cache_creation + true output; the transcript gives 100,644 / 155,124 / 93,208 / 42,524 with placeholder output, so cache_read is not part of that figure.

Agent calls were asynchronous: each Agent tool_result is an 'Async agent launched successfully' acknowledgement 1-29 s after the call (the three page agents' first events are all at 05:28:42.9, after the third launch), and completions arrived as <agent-message> hand-back user turns (Dump 05:30:54, Board 05:31:19, Priorities 05:33:31, ui-verifier 05:39:19), each followed by a <task-notification> user turn with a <usage> block, except Dump, whose notification exists only as a system-kind event at 05:30:52.8 (usage taken from there). `agents_done_at` therefore uses the last hand-back (05:39:19); the literal last Agent tool_result (05:37:07) is only the ui-verifier's launch ack. All three page agents were back by 05:33:31.
